rationale: This role owns Nazdar's ink and coating portfolio strategy, which explicitly emphasizes outdoor durability and UV resistance (2800 Series, 3500 Series, 270 Series, DCA Topcoat). The VP of Product Development would be responsible for differentiating Nazdar's offerings in a competitive market and achieving longer outdoor durability claims. Tedlar's 12-20+ year lifespan and superior UV protection could enable them to develop premium ink+overlaminate system solutions that significantly outperform their current 2-3 year outdoor durability warranties. This directly impacts their ability to compete in fleet graphics, outdoor signage, and architectural graphics segments where extended warranties command premium pricing. Their recent sustainability awards (TLMI Calvin Frost, EcoVadis Silver) suggest this leader cares about long-term performance and environmental responsibility—Tedlar's durability reduces replacement frequency, aligning with sustainability goals while strengthening product positioning.

Nazdar actively exhibits at major trade shows (PRINTING United Expo 2024, ISA Sign Expo 2024) and positions products around outdoor durability performance claims. The Director of Marketing owns competitive differentiation messaging and go-to-market strategy for their ink systems. Partnering with Tedlar would provide powerful proof points for marketing campaigns: transforming '2 years outdoor durability' claims into '12-20+ years with Tedlar overlaminate' creates a dramatic competitive advantage in fleet graphics, vehicle wraps, and architectural applications. This role would also value the graffiti resistance benefit as a unique selling point for transit, outdoor advertising, and municipal signage customers. Given Nazdar's premium positioning and quality focus evidenced by their awards and longevity, this marketing leader needs differentiation tools that justify higher prices and build brand equity—Tedlar provides exactly that story.

With Nazdar SourceOne distribution across 14+ locations serving specialty graphic and textile printing industries, the VP of Sales leads a large team selling into sign shops, print service providers, vehicle wrap installers, and OEM partners. This role is measured on revenue growth, market share gains, and customer retention in competitive ink and supplies markets. Offering Tedlar as a recommended protective overlaminate creates a consultative sales approach that positions Nazdar as a complete solution provider, not just an ink supplier. When customers complain about premature graphic failures, warranty claims, or UV degradation—common pain points in outdoor applications—the sales team can offer a proven solution that protects both the customer's investment and Nazdar's reputation. This role would also appreciate how Tedlar's extreme durability reduces customer churn by eliminating performance failures, while the graffiti resistance feature opens new market opportunities in transit, municipalities, and high-vandalism environments where current solutions fail.
